mapper.select: SELECT COVER_POSTS_IDX, APPLY_MOTIVE, GROWTH_PROCESS, PERSONALITY, JOB_EXPERIENCE, HOPE_JOB, JOBSEEKER_IDX FROM COVER_POSTS WHERE JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobseekerIdx} ORDER BY COVER_POSTS_IDX DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COVER_POSTS_IDX, APPLY_MOTIVE, GROWTH_PROCESS, PERSONALITY, JOB_EXPERIENCE, HOPE_JOB, JOBSEEKER_IDX FROM COVER_POSTS WHERE COVER_POSTS_IDX = #{coverPostsIdx}

SELECT IDINTERVIEW_IDX as idinterviewIdx, INTERVIEW_SCORE as interviewScore, INTERVIEW_REASON as interviewReason, COVER_POSTS_IDX as coverPostsIdx FROM INTERVIEW_RESULT WHERE IDINTERVIEW_IDX = #{idinterviewIdx}
